name: Apple iPhone touchscreen smartphone
description: A touchscreen mobile phone combined voice communications, Web access and applications in a handheld device.

date.label: 29 June 2007
date.basis: Date or stated historical interval in cited source; see caveats.

events.statement: The original iPhone went on sale in the United States in 4 GB and 8 GB models.

contributions.resource: Sold the iPhone; the company used the name Apple Inc. by this time.

evidence.supports: Apple states the 29 June 2007 US sale and initial model prices.

events.caveats: At US launch Apple and AT&T required a new two-year service plan and Internet-connected PC or Mac with iTunes for activation; device price excluded service. Apple also listed an iTunes Store account or major credit card and a valid Social Security number as activation requirements.

evidence.supports: Apple states the 29 June 2007 US sale and initial model prices.
Apple and AT&T list the activation and two-year service plan requirements.

date.label: 14 July 2008
date.basis: Date or stated historical interval in cited source; see caveats.

events.statement: Apple reported more than ten million App Store downloads across iPhone and iPod touch in the first three days.
events.caveats: Downloads are not distinct users or iPhone sales; this event occurred after the 2007 launch.

evidence.supports: Apple states the first-weekend download count and eligible devices.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest sourced event establishing this scoped achievement; it is not a claim of global priority.

measures.money_context: Nominal initial US price for the 4 GB model, before service and other charges.
measures.subject: Original iPhone, 4 GB
measures.conditions: Apple US launch announcement; 8 GB model was $599 and carrier service was additional.

measures.subject: App Store downloads on iPhone and iPod touch in first three days
measures.conditions: Apple-reported aggregate across both device classes; not unique users or sales.

evidence.supports: Apple reports more than ten million downloads in three days.

caveats: Touchscreen phones, mobile Internet and smartphone applications existed before the iPhone. Later App Store access is a separate 2008 event.

research.note: New source-backed draft; independent review pending. Independent review: The iPhone’s Wi-Fi feature used 802.11b/g, but its existence did not require the unmodified 1997 standard record; the overbroad requires link was removed. Independent reader checked Apple’s 2007 US prices, activation conditions and aggregate 2008 App Store downloads; these are not unique users.
